newsitem.title: USA: Leviathan Gas gets $300 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Leviathan Gas gets $300 mln credit facility.

text.p: Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners LP said it received a $300 million revolving credit facility.

The company said it will use the facility to refinance all of its existing debt of about $216.5 million. It will use the rest of the money for working capital and general corporate purposes, the company said.

The facility is co-agented by Chase Manhattan Bank and ING Capital Corp, the company said. It has a three-year initial term, which may be extended for additional one-year periods upon approval of the banks, the company added.
